public_rationale: Zitron guessed that GPT-4.5 would be an upgraded GPT-4o and that it was the model codenamed Orion. OpenAI released GPT-4.5 on February 27, 2025. Its system card says that, building on GPT-4o, GPT-4.5 scales pre-training further. Fortune's launch report identifies GPT-4.5 as the model OpenAI called Orion internally. Both parts of the guess match what OpenAI shipped. This release settles the forecast.
limitations: Altman had already tied GPT-4.5 to Orion before the post, so only the GPT-4o part was a true prediction.
GPT-4.5 is a new, larger pre-training run that builds on GPT-4o, not a fine-tune of GPT-4o. 'Upgraded version' is read broadly to cover this.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Zitron hypothesizes GPT-4.5 will be an upgraded version of GPT-4o, codenamed Orion.

statement.excerpt: Both of these statements vary from vague to meaningless, but I hypothesize the following:GPT-4.5 will be an upgraded version of GPT-4o, OpenAI's foundation model, now codenamed Orion.

from_speaker: GPT-4.5 will be an upgraded version of GPT-4o
our_interpretation: Two parts are tested. (1) GPT-4.5, when released, is a successor that builds on GPT-4o rather than a different kind of model, such as a reasoning model. (2) GPT-4.5 is the model OpenAI called Orion.
No deadline is stated. The release of GPT-4.5, with OpenAI's own description of it, settles the forecast.
criteria.support_condition: OpenAI's release materials or reliable reporting describe GPT-4.5 as building on or succeeding GPT-4o, and identify it as Orion.
criteria.contradiction_condition: GPT-4.5 is released as something other than a GPT-4o successor, such as a reasoning model or a combined system, or it is shown not to be Orion.
